name: CountertopCheck appliance heights and cabinet clearances
about: Published heights, in-use heights and manual clearances for countertop appliances. Every number is quoted from the maker's page or manual (or a named retailer spec tab where the maker blocked access); a missing number is not published.
need: tallest of closed height, in-use height, and closed height plus the clearance the manual asks for above
